paper.title_en: Unfolded Schwinger-Dyson hierarchy for vertex functions
paper.abstract_en: We propose a formulation of a quantum field theory within the framework of the unfolded dynamics approach, originally developed in higher-spin gauge theory. We construct an unfolded system that describes a hierarchy of Schwinger-Dyson equations for vertex functions of a scalar QFT in terms of unfolded first-order equations. A distinctive feature of the constructed system is the appearance of two additional evolution parameters responsible for the WKB and RG behaviors. As an illustration, a one-loop analysis of the theory with quartic self-interaction is carried out.
